## Seller services
We review comparable sales and competing listings, recommend pricing and preparation, coordinate the agreed media scope, position eligible listings in the MLS, contact relevant buyer agents, review feedback and negotiate offers and closing terms.
A comparative market analysis is an estimate, not an appraisal or a guarantee of sale price.
We discuss the seller's next purchase, relocation and possible occupancy arrangements where appropriate. Terms require agreement and documentation. Attorneys and tax advisors handle legal and tax advice.

## First step
Request a private seller strategy review at https://homesprofessional.com/sell#contact or contact Carlos on U.S. WhatsApp. Share the property address, contact details, timing and priorities. Carlos reviews the information and contacts you to arrange the conversation. No fee for the review and no listing commitment.

## Limits
MLS visibility, syndication and referral reach depend on property eligibility, applicable rules, brokerage approval and participating channels. No guaranteed placement, agent attention, inquiries, referrals, price, sale or closing timeline. Current figures and claims must be checked against the dated sources on the relevant page.
